full_text_tesim: Current number of lines on each folio is 12; each original folio had a larger number of lines

Since the original manuscript had a two-column layout, according to the reconstruction of the original position of the palimpsest folios, a more correct representation of the textual order would be one of the two following: (1) 2v+1r, 1v+2r; (2) 2v (col. a), 1r (col. b), 1v (col. a), 2r (col. b)
The text displays some variants compared to the Aland edition
